review_scope: all ten original-resolution individual-renderer black and neutral-gray proofs
root_findings: Isolation, centering, clipping, background visibility and render-texture cleanup are corrected and accepted for reuse.
All five roles have essentially the same low horizontal closed oval silhouette, differing mainly by color and minor edge noise.
The complete-ellipse or pill reading is explicit and fails the mandatory individual-renderer shape gate.
Hot core, shoulder, overturn fold, low fold and terminal ember are not visually distinguishable as separate flame functions.
The shapes are too small and flat for commercial inspection and do not demonstrate layered flame depth or directional flow.
No composite, timing, prefab completion or lifecycle work is authorized from this proof.

r8_binding_requirements.hot_core: A compact forward-tapered axial lick with an uneven fork or concave trailing bite; no closed oval.
r8_binding_requirements.orange_shoulder: A broader asymmetric teardrop shoulder with unequal upper and lower reach and one compressed side; no pill.
r8_binding_requirements.dark_red_overturn_fold: A taller curling overturn lobe or open hook with a visible directional fold; it may not close into a ring or ellipse.
r8_binding_requirements.low_soft_fold: A lower sagging wedge-lobe with a distinct baseline and soft broken tail, visibly different from the upper fold.
r8_binding_requirements.terminal_ember: A small irregular rounded fragment or short torn wisp with unequal axes and a broken perimeter; not a fifth recolored oval.
r8_binding_requirements.depth_and_falloff: Each role must contain an independently visible bright-to-soft falloff and enough internal variation to avoid a flat opaque sticker read.
r8_binding_requirements.proof_scale: Use the accepted clean proof-camera pipeline, but frame each complete silhouette large enough for edge, falloff and asymmetry review with consistent padding.
r8_binding_requirements.stage_limit: Return only the corrected five black/gray pairs. No composite, timeline, 30-cycle, prefab completion or self approval before a new Root decision.
